content.content:
1. One commitment, and its scope stops where other commitments begin. The dependent records one commitment: discarding makes the change the draft's workspace holds go away, and no other change with it; and where the workspace is already gone there is no change the record reaches, so nothing of jj's is reached and jj's state is left alone. Read the dependent's recorded content as a whole and fail on any element that can be decided, changed or dropped on its own without the remaining elements changing; name the element and the separate commitment it settles. Fail likewise on any element whose soundness rests on a decision that no prerequisite in depends_on records; name the element and the missing decision. The record's removal from the store, the removal or forgetting of the discarded draft's jj workspace and its directory, and the verb surface (the command, its name, flags, arguments, output, refusal wording and exit status) are commitments recorded elsewhere and are not edges of this decision; an element that settles or re-settles any of them is a finding under this criterion — name the element and the commitment it duplicates — and the reviewer adds no rule and no edge for it.

2. Licence, applied once per prerequisite in depends_on. No element of the dependent contradicts a prerequisite it names in depends_on. Read the dependent element by element against each prerequisite; fail on every contradicting element, naming the element and the prerequisite it departs from. The prerequisites recorded here decide, among them: a discard ends an open draft without landing; a record has exactly two states, open and landed, and the only transition between them is open to landed, made at the landing; landed is terminal and retained; absence is not a third state; only an open draft is discarded; a discard ends one draft and not an edit and not a node; a discard is not one of the three operations, opens no bracket and writes no marker, and gives undo and redo no unit; a drifted draft — an open record whose workspace jj no longer has — is still an open draft whose discard is not a repair; and a discard leaves no open record for the removal guard to name (tvxspkyy). A change is removed by abandoning it with `jj abandon`, which is the act removal fixes for a dependant-free node, and the node's rationale keeps a refused removal from ever becoming an abandonment (xllzxxvo). A draft's jj workspace is created at the change that owns the draft's node, so its working copy holds that node's owned set as the record's base records it, while how the CLI causes that is not fixed (pvnszwum). A node's id is the id of the jj change that owns it; the id lives in the node's filename and in edge targets, never as document content; and the draft's working-copy change is not a node (xwyryumr). An element that removes a change by an act other than abandoning it (xllzxxvo), that abandons a change other than the one the draft's workspace holds or selects that change from anything but the workspace's start (pvnszwum), that treats the draft's working-copy change as a node or reaches it through a node id (xwyryumr), that makes the abandonment a graph operation or a bracketed one (tvxspkyy), or that would reach a change in a draft whose workspace is gone (tvxspkyy, pvnszwum), contradicts the prerequisite cited there, and the finding names the element and that prerequisite.

3. Each element's soundness rests on a named prerequisite, and each prerequisite carries an element. For every element of the dependent, identify the prerequisite in depends_on whose decision makes that element sound; fail if the element rests on a decision no recorded prerequisite states, naming the element and the missing decision. The identification is read off the element's content, not off any citation the element may carry. Fail also if one of the four prerequisites carries no element of the dependent — the recorded edge would then be unused — naming the unclaimed prerequisite and the edge it was recorded for. An element whose soundness would need the store's removal, the workspace's forgetting, or the verb surface is a finding under criterion 1, not a licence gap under this criterion, because those decisions are not edges of this one.

The criteria read the recorded dependent and its recorded prerequisites as they stand. They require no file, module, flag or command, and no behavior probe; there is nothing to run. A reviewer applies them to the node documents and reports each failure by element and by the prerequisite or the commitment it departs from.
content.rationale:
The dependent is a commitment in words, and all four of its prerequisites carry words as their content, so every edge takes a non-violation gate rather than a behavior probe: a prose prerequisite can only be contradicted by an element of the dependent. Three of the four edges are natural-to-natural and take the base cell verbatim; the fourth (pvnszwum, a requirement sentence) is the structured-to-natural cell, whose matrix entry is the default cell — the gate form plus a flag to extend the matrix — so the form is the same under either reading of that prerequisite and the cell is flagged for a matrix entry. One evaluation covers all four edges because they answer one question — which change a discard makes go away, and by what act — and a single element-by-element pass reads the dependent against all four at once; splitting would read the same elements four times.

Licence alone does not cover this use. The four prerequisites constrain different parts of one act: that the act is abandoning a change with `jj abandon` and not an escape from the removal guard (xllzxxvo); that the change it reaches is the one the draft's workspace holds because the opening put the workspace at the change that owns the node (pvnszwum); that the draft's working-copy change is not a node while a node's id names the change that owns it, so the node's own change is not what the discard abandons (xwyryumr); and that the end is the end of an open draft without landing, not an operation, with a workspace-jj-no-longer-has still an open draft (tvxspkyy). A dependent can contradict none of them and still bundle the abandonment with the store's removal, the workspace's forgetting, or the verb surface, or leave the abandoned change selected by something other than the workspace's start. Criterion 1 tests that the commitment is one and that its scope stops at those other commitments; criterion 3 tests that each element actually rests on one of the four recorded edges and that each of the four carries an element, rather than the decision leaning on an unrecorded one. Criterion 2 is the licence check with each prerequisite's content named so a reviewer can apply it at check time; it pins none of the dependent's wording and names no element of the dependent in advance.

The criteria are applied by reading the recorded nodes; no command runs, and the findings are the reviewer's output. While the dependent's content is a placeholder there is no element stating which change a discard abandons or by what act, so criterion 1 has no commitment to test for atomicity, criterion 2 has no element to license against the four prerequisites, and criterion 3 has no element to rest on a named edge.
